## D — Accuracy and source controls for Driving record and enforcement
The driving record and enforcement facts are authored from the selected official physical pages and preserve the actor, triggering condition and exceptions described there.
Source confidence is high for page fidelity; current legal applicability is limited by the old edition and recorded freshness debt.
Image-only information has not been converted into unsupported facts; any diagram-dependent learning surface needs its own evidence review.
The preaccept fact-check receipt is same-model review only; independent coverage and fact QA remain pending.
Detailed DUI sentences, fine ranges, suspension/interlock matrices, ARD dispositions and refusal-fee schedules await current official verification (verify PA-RECORD-PENALTY-MATRICES).
Online record-purchase requirements and crash-report mailing details are service-currentness debt (verify PA-RECORD-SERVICES).
Unperioded fleeing and teen mortality statistics are withheld as current estimates (verify PA-RECORD-STATISTICS).
